facts.offer: Introductory pricing for the first three months
facts.conditions: The official US VPS page currently displays introductory pricing for the first three months with a one-year contract. State and local taxes apply. Refer to the cards shown when you open the official page for the specific plans and amounts.
facts.label: US VPS pricing

facts.conditions: The official VPS trial page offers a refund if dissatisfied within 30 days. This is a money-back arrangement, not a claim that no payment is required.
facts.label: VPS trial and refund explanation

faq.question: Is there a verified IONOS promo code?
faq.answer: No public code was verified on the official pages reviewed. The VPS product page displays introductory prices and Add to cart links. Choose the plan there and confirm the order price.

faq.question: Does the introductory price last for the whole contract?
faq.answer: No. The listed introductory period is three months with a one-year term. Confirm subsequent billing and renewal charges in the order details.

faq.question: Is the VPS trial permanently free?
faq.answer: No. IONOS describes a 30-day money-back guarantee on its VPS trial page.
